mechanism: Call the inherited AcquisitionEndpoint exactly once. Only its first false-to-true retired transition may arm a readback. Return at most two current samples while raw report, detached identity, complete sole ownership, mean quiet and the existing low>=3 certificate all remain true. Never clear parent retirement.
bound_proof: Within one detached acquisition, inherited retired can transition false-to-true at most once because this adapter never clears it.
Each readback output decrements remaining; no other path increments it.
Any proof loss sets remaining=0 and cannot rearm before a real inherited endpoint reset.
An inherited fail-open raw route may remain high on its own sample, but readback_active is false and the adapter never suppresses legacy_output.

evaluation.d4: all 385 disclosed physical cases, R31 held identity vs readback, with registered references and original guards
evaluation.r26: full disclosed 78 inputs per arm, R31 held identity vs readback (156 episodes)
evaluation.cross: run only as a post-result diagnostic if the fixed candidate has positive width gain and no hard protection failure

success: recover one or two detached active samples beyond R31 held identity
no new rise, duplicate, false, prealarm, stuck output or strict loss
no onset change and no parent legacy_output change
preserve attributable close second and all registered physics/forces
falsifiers: more than two readback_active samples in one continuous detached acquisition
readback after a raw gap, ownership loss, nonsole route, grip or short-low loss
legacy_output differs from unmodified R31 held identity
any new D4 or R26 protection failure
